decisions.because: Counterexample (hunt round 3, 2026-10-10): the default was 64512:(node_id & 0xFFFF), so nodes 1 and 65537 shared 64512:1 and would withdraw each other's rules on a shared gobgpd (ADR-0008).

statement: The default ownership community is 64512:<node-id>; a node id that does not fit 16 bits is refused at startup unless a community is given explicitly, never truncated.
